mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly lower than the baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the return distribution in low-unemployment periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential construction starts above 1.4 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances, or the average return in high-HOUST periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the return in low-INDPRO periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a coordinated monetary tightening in response to inflation, which raises real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 55% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS and decline in UNRATE signals a robust labor market recovery that increases consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60d returns in less than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 370 billion dollars signals strong household demand, which boosts corporate sales and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances, or the average return in high-RSAFS periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 and a concurrent drop in GDP growth below 1.5% annualized signal a weakening economy, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in less than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).
